questionText: If a child has a Chronological Age (CA) of 8 years and a Mental Age (MA) of 10 years, what is the child's Intelligence Quotient (IQ)?

Hence, option (B) is correct.

questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: Active listening requires the listener to suspend personal judgments, maintain eye contact, and provide constructive feedback.
Statement II: Empathy is an innate biological reflex that requires zero cognitive effort or specialized training.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
